messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++11 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
int power(int a,int b)
{
    long long ans=1;
    while(b)
    {
        ans*=a;
        ans%=MOD;
        --b;
    }
    return ans;
}
int main()
{
	int p,k;
	cin>>p>>k;
	if(k==0)
		cout<<power(p,p-1);
	else if(k==1)
		cout<<power(p,p);
	else
	{
		int ord = 1, cur = k;
		while(cur!=1)
		{
			cur = (long long) cur * k % p;
			ord += 1;
		}     		
		cout<<power(p,(p-1)/ord);
	}
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
